content.text:
**Finding: Deviation (high severity) — Section 7.7 (p0032)**

Section 7.7 requires Customer to pay Vendor "as liquidated damages and not as a penalty" 15% of annual Fees for *each week* an invoice is unpaid, triggered after only ten days. This fails the preferred position (no Customer-payable LDs/penalties) and the fallback (single early-termination amount capped at three months' fees), and reaches walk-away territory: the weekly accrual can exceed remaining contract value and is triggered by a minor breach.

No other Customer-payable LD, minimum fee, or shortfall charge exists — Sections 9.4 and 10 confirm Customer owes only accrued Fees on termination.

Redline (validated, ok:true): replace 7.7 with customary simple interest at 1%/month on proper undisputed invoices unpaid 30 days past due, plus an express statement that no LD or penalty is payable by Customer — preserving the Section 7.3 dispute-withholding right.
